SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.status, t.teacher_no, t.department, t.title, t.courses FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN teacher_info t ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role_type = 2
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.department LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND t.department = #{department}
ORDER BY u.username ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.status, t.teacher_no, t.department, t.title, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(ts.course_name, '(', ts.class_start, '-', ts.class_end, '班)') ORDER BY ts.course_name SEPARATOR ',') AS courses FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN teacher_info t ON t.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN teacher_semester ts ON ts.teacher_id = u.id AND ts.semester_id = #{semesterId} WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role_type = 2
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.department LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND t.department = #{department}
GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.status, t.teacher_no, t.department, t.title ORDER BY u.username ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.status, t.teacher_no, t.department, t.title, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ts.course_name ORDER BY ts.course_name SEPARATOR '、') AS courses FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN teacher_info t ON t.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN teacher_semester ts ON ts.teacher_id = u.id AND ts.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND ts.class_start <= #{classNum} AND ts.class_end >= #{classNum} WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role_type = 2
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.department LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.status, t.teacher_no, t.department, t.title ORDER BY u.username ASC
